name: Example - Forms & States (FREE PLAY)
author: LoG2 Co-op
description: A form you only get as a mission reward (ULTRA BLUE for Goku - talk to the MASTER near the start, beat 10 foes), a move that turns you BERSERK when it ends (LIMIT BREAK, Goku level 5), a POISON BALL that poisons foes, and wolf-type foes (kind 8) that can slow you down. See FORMS, MOVES, MISSIONS, STATES and ENEMIES.
